title: Amtrak accessibility reliability retains a bounded watch
summary: Retain the named-accessibility-asset reliability signal In Review. The June ADA report provides construction and installation progress, the November 24 annual results provide aggregate performance and accessibility milestones, and the November 9 Chicago announcement describes a prospective platform project. None of the inspected material supplies the required repeated named-asset reliability series.
evidence_note: Actual inspection November 26 catches up the November 25 follow-up; original primary schedule October 9 and the October 28 decision remain intact. The June ADA reporting window is November 1, 2025–April 30, 2026, distinct from the Canada accessibility report used in October. Installation totals, fleet-level results and prospective construction benefits are not repeated accessibility-asset uptime or repair observations. This bounded review does not establish nonexistence or decide the independent PIDS financial-closeout gate. PDF text was inspected, not signatures or visual layout.
publication_effect: Local dated context only. In Review signals, earlier authority and exactly thirteen cycle identities are retained. No independent stage, qualification, capacity or release admission.
